note: Hard supersession fixture. One offline check-suite count moves 214 -> 226 -> 238 -> 241 (LAN) -> 251 -> 247 -> 262 -> 334/341 -> 358/371 across thirty chunks, and the bank is crowded on purpose: the suite result is restated in three registers (a heavy summary-report form, a one-line terse form, and a plain command form), stale numbers come back as log and document evidence, and a dozen unrelated durable facts share the same words. The point is a bank where the reconcile call cannot see every count claim at once and where an old claim ranks above the current one. `facts` is the authored expectation: what a correct writer banks at each chunk, marked `stale` when the chunk brings back a number the suite has already moved past and `retire` when a correct writer would have retired it by the end. Content is invented: a pipeline controller CLI called pnctl. No hostnames, no absolute paths, no credentials.
